ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, there is a long horizontal straight line extending all the way to the right endpoint C. Segment AB slants downward from A above to B, and intersects this horizontal line; at the intersection point, the upper angle formed by AB and the right side of the horizontal line is labeled 104°. Segment BC slants upward to the right from B to C, ∠8 is marked near C, and is the acute angle between BC and the horizontal line. The problem gives AB ⟂ BC. Reasoning: Because AB is perpendicular to BC, the angle between AB and BC is 90°. In the figure, the angle of AB related to the same direction of the horizontal line is 104°, therefore the acute angle between BC and this horizontal line is 104° − 90° = 14°. So ∠8 = 14°.

raw_record.question_text: Find the measure of $\angle 8$ if $\overline{A B} \perp \overline{B C}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the long horizontal segment through the crossing point and C is a straight line, angle 8 is the acute angle between this horizontal line and BC at C, and the angle marked 104° is the angle between AB and the horizontal line on the upper-right side of their intersection. From the text, use AB ⟂ BC, so the angle between AB and BC is 90°. Since AB makes 104° with the horizontal direction, BC must make 104° − 90° = 14° with that same horizontal line. Therefore angle 8 is 14.

图像描述：附图中有一条长水平直线一直延伸到右端点 C。线段 AB 从上方的 A 斜向下到 B，并与这条水平线相交；在交点处，AB 与水平线右侧形成的上方角标为 104°。线段 BC 从 B 斜向右上到 C，∠8 标在 C 附近，是 BC 与水平线之间的锐角。题目给出 AB ⟂ BC。
推理：因为 AB 垂直 BC，所以 AB 与 BC 的夹角是 90°。图中 AB 与水平线同一方向相关的角为 104°，因此 BC 与该水平线的锐角为 104° − 90° = 14°。所以 ∠8 = 14°。

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the auxiliary slanted ray from B crosses the horizontal line and forms a 40° angle above the horizontal; the angle marked 104° is formed by AB and the horizontal; the auxiliary ray splits the right angle at B into angles 5 and 6; angle 8 is at C in triangle formed by B, the auxiliary-ray intersection with the horizontal, and C. From the image, AB makes 104° with the horizontal while the auxiliary ray makes 40° with the horizontal, so angle 5 between AB and the auxiliary ray is 104° − 40° = 64°. From the text, AB ⟂ BC, so angle 5 + angle 6 = 90°, giving angle 6 = 26°. At the horizontal intersection, the interior angle of triangle BEC adjacent to the 40° angle is 180° − 40° = 140°. Then in triangle BEC, angle 8 = 180° − 140° − 26° = 14.

推理：图中 AB 与水平线形成的方向角为 104°，辅助斜射线与水平线形成的方向角为 40°，所以 AB 与辅助斜射线之间的角 5 为 104° - 40° = 64°。题目给出 AB ⟂ BC，因此角 ABC 是 90°，即角 5 + 角 6 = 90°，所以角 6 = 90° - 64° = 26°。在辅助斜射线与水平线的交点处，三角形 BEC 的内角与标出的 40° 构成一条直线上的邻补角，所以该内角为 180° - 40° = 140°。在三角形 BEC 中，三个内角和为 180°，因此角 8 = 180° - 140° - 26° = 14°。
